title: P18-C parallel admission gating — DEPENDS_ON/CONFLICTS constraints on the auto-scheduler claim path
description: P18-C: the canonical relation substrate now GATES autonomous admission (first non-inert consumer). ObjectiveRelationService.admissionView — STRICT ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstreams + CONFLICTS partners: corrupt rows propagate loudly (a corrupted-but-real edge can never silently clear admission), semantic unproven-ness (forged/owner-amended edges) drops rows so fabrication can never gate. R1-F1 fix — per-endpoint edge index (objective_relation_index keyed OBJ:REL) makes the gate O(degree) not O(global table): pointers entity-hash-proven + still fully re-prove their named relation; dangling/tampered pointers wedge (FAIL_CLOSED_RELATION_INDEX); a resumable chunked rebuild (INDEX_CHUNK=64, cursor in objective_relation_index_state marker) migrates legacy rows inside write txs — scheduler claim()/nextFairCandidate() advance it in their OWN committed tx so progress survives later wedges; marker un-built → identical strict global fallback (claimable() stays read-only). Shared scheduler predicate relationGate: UPSTREAM_UNMET when any ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstream is not ACHIEVED (pending AND terminally-failed both block); CONFLICT_LEASE_HELD when an ACTIVE CONFLICTS partner holds a live lease — mutual exclusion on the parallel lane. Wired at all three claim-path seams: claimable() (read-only readiness; roster mirror now mirrors activeRoster's invalid() on missing lease rows), nextFairCandidate() (gated candidates skipped transiently; one activeRoster snapshot per scan), claim() (gate LAST before mint — atomic with roster under immediate; retry-exhausted marker ordering preserved). Admission-only: mid-execution relations never kill a live lease. Manual/operator admission unaffected. Codex-only.
